300767.name: Chabad of NW Coral Springs (the Chai Center)
300767.note: Its own About page: 'Established in 2005, The Chai Center Chabad is directed by Rabbi Hershy Bronstein and his wife Chanie' (an independent affiliate of the Chabad Centers of Coral Springs). Chabad.org (CrownHeights.info, 1 Sept 2015) agrees: the Bronsteins 'have led this Chabad center in the city for the past decade, starting with small prayer gatherings in their apartment'; the 9,500-square-foot building (5761 Coral Ridge Drive) opened 13 Aug 2015.

earlier.where: a 1,300-square-foot storefront near the present building

118514.name: Downtown Jewish Center Chabad
118514.note: Its own home page has both: 'DJCC has been serving the Fort Lauderdale community since 2000' and 'Rabbi Schneur & Devorah Kaplan, emissaries of the Lubavitcher Rebbe, founded the Downtown Jewish Center Chabad in 2003.' Directory listings (Las Olas Boulevard association; MapQuest) also say 2000. The earlier year is used; the two disagree, so medium. (VIN News, 2009: then not on chabad.org's list.) 900 E Broward Blvd.

2301323.name: Beis Menachem
2301323.note: Its own home page: 'The Community Shul Since 1989'; 'For over 35 years, Bais Menachem has stood as a cornerstone of the Chabad-Lubavitch community in Miami Beach'. Mikvah.org (news item now removed; from the search index) agrees: it 'was established in 1989, when the Chabad community in the 41st Street area of Miami Beach had grown sufficiently in size to require its own shul', with Rabbi Yehuda Leib Schapiro as rav. Now at 444 West 40th Street. therebbesimpact.com says 1987.

118352.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Wellington
118352.note: Town-Crier (1 Feb 2013, its 'Bar Mitzvah'): 'Chabad is celebrating 13 years of reaching out to the community'; Rabbi Mendy Muskal: 'Within six weeks of arrival, we already had a group of people for a High Holiday get-together' (so summer 1999). Wellington the Magazine (1 Dec 2025): the Muskals have been in Wellington 'for more than 25 years', moving from Kentucky, which agrees. IRS: 'Chabad Lubavitch Of Wellington Inc', exempt from Feb 2002.

4045086.name: Chabad of Nocatee
4045086.note: CrownHeights.info, 21 Aug 2013, 'New Shluchim to Northern Florida': Rabbi Mendel and Dini Sharfstein 'have been appointed by Rabbi Y. Kahanov ... as the directors of the latest Chabad Center on the First Coast to serve as a Center for Jewish Life for St. John's' (St. Johns, Nocatee, World Golf Village; the sixth center in greater Jacksonville). Now Chabad at St. Johns County, 1571 Lemonwood Rd.

5583706.name: Alef Preschool of Palm Beach
5583706.note: CrownHeights.info (from the Palm Beach Daily News), 19 May 2021: Eric and Svetlana Silverman gave $1 million to the Alef Preschool of Palm Beach (Rabbi Zalman and Hindel Levitin); 'The new preschool is already planning on opening for the 2022-2023 school year, and is in the process of leasing a space', director Shterny Schochet. A child-care directory had it licensed at 165 Bradley Place by Aug 2024. The actual opening is not confirmed: after May 2021, by 2024.

4732397.name: Chabad of North Beach
4732397.note: Chabad Ocean Drive (Hollywood/Hallandale Beach), 'Our Rabbis & Rebbetzins': in 2019 Chabad expanded 'with the arrival of Rabbi Sholom Ber & Malka Kudan who moved from Jerusalem, Israel'; 'They provide a Chabad presence on Hollywood's North Beach.' The chabad.org listing (4732397) is from about 2019, which agrees.

1019035.name: Friendship Circle
1019035.note: Its own Give Miami Day profile (Friendship Circle Miami Beach North Dade, 260 95th St., Surfside): 'Founded in 2009'. Contact Mendy Dechter. The chabad.org listing (1019035) is from about 2009, which agrees. (The separate Friendship Circle of Miami, Kendall, dates from 2004.)
